svg.title: Downunder Voices Cartoon of the Day — Which one is the moon?
svg.desc: Original pen-and-ink editorial cartoon. On a beach at night beneath a rocky headland with pandanus palms, two tall floodlight towers marked "Night surf trial" blaze across the waves so a lone surfer can ride a breaking wave. Freshly hatched baby sea turtles climb out of a nest beside a "Turtle nesting — please keep lights low" sign and march along the sand towards the floodlights instead of the sea. A fictional beach ranger in a wide-brimmed hat and hi-vis vest points up at the real moon, while the lead hatchling looks up at the lights and asks, "Which one of those is the moon?"
svg.text: DOWNUNDER VOICES — CARTOON OF THE DAY
SNAPPER'S NIGHT-SURF TRIAL HAS SOME VERY SMALL CRITICS.
Source: ABC Gold Coast, 4 Nov 2026 — a council committee backed night-surf lights at Snapper Rocks; a turtle expert urged caution.
